vocabulary.definition: 一次施放或一次攻击能对多个敌方单位造成伤害
移除目标身上可被弱驱散的效果
降低目标护甲
跟着单位持续影响周围单位；对友军或敌方都算，并记作用对象；固定在地上的区域归场地魔法
说明明确写打断持续施法；眩晕、沉默等已有控制不重复记
攻击造成额外倍数伤害；有概率触发或强化下一次攻击都算
吸收一定伤害、按比例减少受到的伤害，或把受到的伤害延迟结算（如统帅朗姆酒、虚妄之诺）
处于减益免疫（技能免疫）时，只有能穿透减益免疫的效果才对其生效（如碎颅锤的重击可以眩晕开了黑皇杖的单位）
拉、推、交换、投掷其他单位（如动人之舐、移形换位）
提供额外金钱或经验；只是正常赏金不算
单位进入虚无状态：无法攻击，也不会受到物理攻击；魔法和纯粹伤害仍可作用
目标低于生命阈值时直接杀死
提供目标或区域的视野
恢复生命值（治疗、生命恢复），含属性生命恢复（如治疗指环+4.5）
使自身、队友、召唤物或复制体隐身
降低目标魔抗，或让目标受到更多魔法或技能伤害
减少目标的法力值
为自己恢复或从其他单位抽取法力（如莱恩法力吸取），含属性回蓝和回蓝倍率；对友军生效且能给自己回蓝的也算
攻击无视闪避（必中）
使隐身单位显形，不等于持续真视
目标无法移动；带ROOT_DISABLES字段的位移（所有闪烁类）也不能使用
降低移动速度或攻击速度
降低自身受到的减速效果（如散夜对剑+30%）
提高技能造成的伤害
使指向自身或队友的技能失效
把指向技能反弹给施法者
可看见隐身单位

objects.subject: dagon_3
objects.description_en: Active: Energy Burst  Emits a powerful burst of magical damage upon a targeted enemy unit. Upgradable.  Damage: %damage%  Mana Cost: %mana_cost_tooltip%
notes_en: Instantly kills illusions.
Cast Range bonuses from Aether Lens and Dagon do not stack.

objects.description_en: Active: Energy Burst  Emits a powerful burst of magical damage upon a targeted enemy unit. Upgradable.  Damage: %damage%  Mana Cost: %mana_cost_tooltip%
notes_en: Instantly kills illusions.
Cast Range bonuses from Aether Lens and Dagon do not stack.

objects.subject: dagon_5
objects.description_en: Active: Energy Burst  Emits a powerful burst of magical damage upon a targeted enemy unit.   Damage: %damage%  Mana Cost: %mana_cost_tooltip%
notes_en: Instantly kills illusions.
Cast Range bonuses from Aether Lens and Dagon do not stack.

objects.subject: desolator
objects.description_en: Passive: Corruption  Your attacks reduce the target's armor by %corruption_armor% for %corruption_duration% seconds.   Passive: Soul Stealer  Desolator gains +%bonus_damage_per_kill% damage every time an enemy hero dies while affected by Corruption, to a maximum of %max_damage%.
notes_en: Armor reduction works on buildings.

objects.subject: devastator
objects.description_en: Passive: Witch Blade  Causes your next attack to have true strike, apply a poison for %slow_duration% seconds, slowing by %slow%%% and dealing %int_damage_multiplier%x your intelligence as damage every second.   Passive: Magic Corruption  Your attacks reduce the enemy's Magic resistance by %active_mres_reduction%%% for %passive_cooldown% seconds.

objects.subject: diffusal_blade
objects.description_en: Active: Inhibit  Targets an enemy, slowing it for %purge_slow_duration% seconds.   Passive: Manabreak Each attack burns %feedback_mana_burn% mana from the target, and deals %damage_per_burn% physical damage per burned mana.   Illusions do not burn mana.
notes_en: Does not stack with other diffusal blades.

objects.subject: disperser
objects.description_en: Active: Suppress  Dispels both the wearer and the target. Enemy targets are slowed for %enemy_effect_duration% seconds. Allied targets gain bonus movespeed and %slow_resist%%% slow resistance for %ally_effect_duration% seconds. Caster is always granted the ally benefit on cast.  Both movement speed reduction and increase start at %phase_movement_speed%%% and gradually decrease to 0% over the course of the buff duration. Dispel Type:  Basic Dispel    Passive: Manabreak Each attack burns %feedback_mana_burn% mana from the target, and deals %damage_per_burn% physical damage per burned mana.   Illusions do not burn mana.

objects.subject: dust
objects.description_en: Use: Reveal For %duration% seconds, creates an area that reveals and slows invisible heroes by %movespeed%%% in a %radius% radius where the caster was standing. Invisible units revealed by dust take %damage% damage.   The debuff effect on enemies lingers for %linger_duration%s after leaving the area of effect.
notes_en: Places a debuff on enemy units in the area that reveals them when they are invisible.

objects.subject: echo_sabre
objects.description_en: Passive: Echo Strike  Causes melee attacks to attack twice in quick succession. The double attacks apply a %movement_slow%%% movement slow for %slow_duration% seconds on the first strike.

objects.subject: enchanted_mango
objects.description_en: Use: Eat Mango  Instantly restores %replenish_amount% mana.
notes_en: Hold Control to use on a nearby allied hero.

objects.subject: essence_distiller
objects.description_en: Active: Soul Release  Provides %soul_heal_amount% health regeneration when cast on allies.  Can be ground targeted to lie dormant for up to %ground_duration%s and attach to the first enemy that comes within %latch_range% radius. When on enemies, deals %soul_damage_amount% damage per second and provides True Sight over them and shares their vision with the wearer's team.  Lasts %duration% seconds.  Gains charges every time an enemy hero dies within %soul_radius% units.
notes_en: Empty distillers gain 2 charges.
Only the closest Essence Distiller to the dying hero will gain a charge.
If the allied unit is attacked by an enemy hero or Roshan, the effect is lost.
Does not trigger spell block or spell reflect.
While dormant, provides vision in %latch_vision% radius. Vision lingers for %linger_after_latch_duration%s after latching.

objects.subject: ethereal_blade
objects.description_en: Active: Ether Blast Converts the target unit to ethereal form, rendering them immune to physical damage, but unable to attack and %ethereal_damage_bonus%%% more vulnerable to magic damage.    Enemy targets are also slowed by %blast_movement_slow%%%, and take %blast_stat_multiplier%x the sum of all your attributes + %blast_damage_base% as magical damage. Duration: %duration% seconds
notes_en: Shares cooldown with Ghost Scepter and its upgrades.
Ethereal units take %ethereal_damage_bonus%%% bonus magic damage.

objects.subject: faerie_fire
objects.description_en: Use: Imbue  Instantly restores %hp_restore% health.

objects.subject: falcon_blade
objects.description_en: Passive: Sacrament Each time the wearer attacks an enemy hero, they gain a stack of %mana_regen_per_stack% bonus mana regen, up to %stack_limit% stacks. Stacks last for %stack_duration% seconds.

objects.subject: flask
objects.description_en: Use: Salve  Grants %health_regen% health regeneration to the target for %buff_duration% seconds.  If the unit is attacked by an enemy hero or Roshan, the effect is lost.  Heals for half the amount per second when cast on an ally.

objects.subject: force_staff
objects.description_en: Active: Force Pushes any target unit %push_length% units in the direction it is facing.
notes_en: Self-cast will cause you to use Force on yourself.
Force Staff doesn't interrupt the target's actions.
Will not work on a unit inside Chronosphere, Duel, or Black Hole.
Force Staff has %enemy_cast_range% cast range when cast on enemies.

objects.subject: gem
objects.description_en: Active: Reveal  Gives True Sight over a %active_radius% radius revealing wards and units even in Fog of War.  Passive: True Sight  Grants the ability to see invisible units and wards to any allied vision within %radius% range of its carrier.    Passive: Everlasting  Dropped on death, and cannot be destroyed.
notes_en: Disabled while on a courier.

objects.subject: ghost
objects.description_en: Active: Ghost Form  You enter ghost form for %duration% seconds, becoming immune to physical damage, but are unable to attack and %extra_spell_damage_percent%%% more vulnerable to magic damage.
notes_en: Ends if you become Debuff Immune, and will have no effect if you are already Debuff Immune.
Shares cooldown with all Ghost Scepter upgrades.

objects.subject: glimmer_cape
objects.description_en: Active: Glimmer  After a %initial_fade_delay% second delay, grants invisibility, %active_movement_speed% movement speed and a magic damage barrier that absorbs up to %barrier_block% damage to you or a target allied unit for %duration% seconds.  Can be cast while channeling.

objects.subject: greater_crit
objects.description_en: Passive: Critical Strike Grants each attack a %crit_chance%%% chance to deal %crit_multiplier%%% damage.
notes_en: Critical Strike does not work against buildings.

objects.subject: guardian_greaves
objects.description_en: Active: Mend Restores %replenish_health% health and %replenish_mana% mana to nearby allies, and removes most negative effects from the caster.  Radius: %replenish_radius% Dispel Type:  Basic Dispel    Passive: Guardian Aura  Grants %aura_health_regen% health regeneration and %aura_mana_regen% mana regeneration to allied units. If the wearer's health falls below %aura_bonus_threshold%%%, their health regeneration is increased to %aura_health_regen_bonus%.   Radius: %aura_radius%  Movement speed bonuses from multiple pairs of boots do not stack.
notes_en: Mend does not affect units that have been affected by Mend or Mekansm Restore within Guardian Greaves' cooldown.

objects.subject: gungir
objects.description_en: Active: Eternal Chains Roots all enemies in a %radius_tooltip% radius for %duration% seconds.
notes_en: AoE bonuses from multiple Chasm Stones or its upgrades do not stack.

objects.subject: hand_of_midas
objects.description_en: Active: Transmute  Kills a non-hero target for %bonus_gold% gold. Killing a neutral creep additionally grants a madstone bundle.    Cannot be used on Ancient creeps.
notes_en: The gold given is unreliable gold (you do not get the normal creep bounty).
Experience gained by using Transmute is not shared.

objects.subject: harpoon
objects.description_en: Active: Draw Forth  When targeting an enemy, fire a harpoon at them, that pulls you and the target closer together, up to %pull_distance_pct%%% of the distance between you and your target. If the caster is melee, the hero and target are always pulled to within melee distance of each other. Targeting a tree always pulls you all the way to that tree.   Passive: Echo Strike  Causes melee attacks to attack twice in quick succession. The double attacks apply a %movement_slow%%% movement slow for %slow_duration% seconds on the first strike. Echo Strike cooldown: %passive_cooldown%s

objects.subject: headdress
objects.description_en: Passive: Regeneration Aura Grants %aura_health_regen% health regeneration to allies.  Radius: %aura_radius%
